status_note: Fixed upstream ([apache/datafusion#21060](https://github.com/apache/datafusion/issues/21060), PR [#21405](https://github.com/apache/datafusion/pull/21405), merged 2026-04-09): `translate` uses code points on 55.0.0.
summary: `translate` maps grapheme clusters, so a combining mark stays with its base character: `translate('ée', 'e', 'x')` is `'éx'`. PostgreSQL and DuckDB map code points.
handling: `translate` is not modelled (`core/Sverify/Core/Text.lean`, #60); modelling it per code point is planned, refused on DataFusion 51.
found_by: audit of DataFusion's limits on the shared path (2026-11-08)
